request.focus: breath futures, moving architecture, embodied diplomacy, readable spatial consequences
request.brief: Inside a colossal biomechanical lung orbiting a gas giant, breathable atmosphere is traded as futures and each exhalation tide changes which institutions can reach one another. Build six or more functionally distinct rooms, twelve deeply interdependent named agents, explicit scarce resources, enforceable contracts, rival institutions, and player actions that visibly alter room access, prices, trust, and air pressure. Every room needs one or two premise-specific semantic hero props. Keep the visual language coherent and inspectable: top-down pixel world, oxidized teal membranes, ivory ceramic pressure hardware, saffron signal threads, charcoal shadows, no visible labels, no generic cyberpunk neon, no medieval fantasy, no Beijing or antique-market leakage.
